APIKulture. An alternative to Postman/Insomnia/Bruno.

To be honest, I started this because Postman and Insomnia became forced-corporate-cloud not usable for me anymore, and Bruno lacked a feature I considered fundamental for my workflow.

The feature is to remember the JSONPath expressions between requests, a feature that Bruno has implemented already.

But I created this thing and I'm using it daily since then. C++ and wxWidgets, it uses 40MB of RAM, and it is super fast, instead of the 400MB used by the above mentioned programs.

https://www.apikulture.com/
